settlement: Reedwick, a stilt village over a swamp, mossy and crooked, a fishing village

answer.title: A reed-thatched granary on stilts
answer.why: You carry seeds: a raised granary with a walled plot would keep Reedwick fed through the wet months.
answer.notes: Raised on mossy piles above the damp, with a reed thatch, a drying loft and a small walled garden plot beside it.
